messages:
oncall-alex: Pager: Helion (dedicated, eu-west-1) reporting spike in 5xx routing errors across chat endpoints. Seeing increased error rate starting 5023456770. Paging SRE.
incident-bot: Incident created: P1 - helion-dedicated-eu-routing (https://pager.example/INC-8932). Initial severity: SEV2 -> SEV1 @ 5023456789.
maria-sre: looking at proxy logs now, hit a sudden surge of 502/504 from allocator pool. Possible routing table flaps.
sam-eng-lead: any indication of config rollout? any PRs merged to routing service in last hour?
ops-jordan: nope, no deploys in last 2 hours on control plane. I see increased latency on node-gw-05.
eng-ryan: grabbing heap/profile from node-gw-05. running: 
```
ssh node-gw-05
sudo journalctl -u gw-proxy -n 500 | grep ERROR | tail -n 50
```

maria-sre: quick mitigation idea: add temporary routing rule to isolate Helion's ASG and route to fallback pool. Can we flip that safely?
oncall-alex: approved. Jordan, can you execute the failover? I'll coordinate CS comms.
ops-jordan: doing canary failover to fallback-pool-2 now (manual). Starting at 5023456812.
eng-ryan: pushed routing override to control plane: `routing.set_override(customer=helion, target=fallback-pool-2, ttl=15m)`
maria-sre: monitoring metrics — error rate dropping but still elevated. Token-level failures for certain long-context requests.
sam-eng-lead: root cause hypothesis: allocator cache eviction + a bad kernel param combo causing transient connection resets under higher seq lengths. Need longer postmortem but focus on restore first.
liz-cs: drafting customer-facing message for Helion account team. Suggest: short tailored impact + actions + ETA. Sharing draft below. Please review.
statusbot: Suggested status page entry prepared. Use `/status post` to publish a draft.
liz-cs: DRAFT to Helion contacts: 
"Hello Helion team — We are investigating an issue affecting your dedicated EU inference cluster where some requests are returning transient errors (502/504). Impact: customer-facing API calls may intermittently fail for up to ~20% of requests, primarily long-context chat sessions. Action: We have routed traffic to a fallback pool and are monitoring. ETA: next update in 15 minutes. Primary contact: liz-cs@redwood.ai, oncall: alex. We will follow up with a detailed timeline and RCA"
maria-sre: minor edit: change "20%" to "up to 15%" based on latest metrics. Also add note about no data loss.
liz-cs: updated. Ready to send to Helion CSMs. Who can approve external comms?
sam-eng-lead: I approve the text. Add bullet: "No customer data was accessed or altered."
oncall-alex: +1. Send when I confirm full recovery or at next scheduled update (whichever first).
eng-ryan: recovery logs: after failover error rate dropped from 18% -> 3% in 2m. Some remaining 5xx from in-flight KV cache misses.
ops-jordan: failover completed. Rolling back agressive keepalive tweaks we tried earlier.
incident-bot: Pager updated: responders: oncall-alex, maria-sre, eng-ryan, ops-jordan; severity remains P1.
statusbot: Draft status entry: 
```
Investigating: Customers on Helion dedicated cluster in EU may experience intermittent 502/504 errors. We have applied a temporary routing failover and are monitoring. Next update ~15 minutes.
```

eng-ryan: also posting quick mitigation snippet for runbook for oncall: 
```
1) `routing.set_override(customer=..., target=...)`
2) monitor metrics: /dash/helion/errors
3) if >10% persist, scale fallback pool: infra.scale_pool(fallback-pool-2, +2)
4) collect gw-proxy logs: sudo journalctl -u gw-proxy -o short-iso
```

maria-sre: collecting logs for SR, saving to /var/tmp/helion-5023456789.tar.gz and pushing to secure artefacts.
liz-cs: I've emailed Helion account leads and CSMs with approved text and asked them to expect an update. Sent at 5023456850.
oncall-alex: excellent. keep this thread for updates and handoff to postmortem owner. Postmortem owner: sam-eng-lead.
sam-eng-lead: assigned postmortem. Please add any follow-up action items here. I'll kick off timeline once we have stable metrics.
eng-ryan: final note: we should check kernel tcp_retries2 and allocator eviction thresholds for similar customers. Adding to action list.
incident-bot: Incident resolved? No - monitoring in watchful state.
statusbot: Scheduled status update posted to status.redwood.ai/d/helion (draft) at 5023456860.
oncall-alex: closing pager rotation in 10m if no regressions. thanks all :thumbsup:
